replacements.old: - The README documents Total Commander Secure FTP/SFTP (private + public key), WinSCP (private key only), default SFTP port 22, and the expected server-managed permission warning for Samba-backed sandboxes; do not include a concrete host.
replacements.new: - The README documents Total Commander Secure FTP/SFTP (private + public key), WinSCP (private key only), and the expected server-managed permission warning for Samba-backed sandboxes. Mail and README also include runtime connection data: `cfg.machineInfo.hostname_full` (fallback static hostname) as the primary hostname, locally detected global IPv4 addresses as fallback/diagnostic values, `tun*` IPv4 addresses for VPN access, and effective SSH ports from `sshd -T`; do not call an external public-IP service.

def test_connection_info_uses_app_hostname_interfaces_and_effective_sshd_port(self):
        interfaces = [
            SimpleNamespace(name="eth0", ipv4="8.8.8.8"),
            SimpleNamespace(name="eth1", ipv4="192.168.1.10"),
            SimpleNamespace(name="tun0", ipv4="10.8.88.1"),
        ]
        machine = SimpleNamespace(
            hostname_full="new21.dvestezar.cz",
            static_hostname="new21",
        )
        sshd_result = SimpleNamespace(
            returncode=0,
            stdout="port 2222\n",
            stderr="",
        )

        with patch.object(sftp_hlp.app_cfg, "machineInfo", machine), patch.object(
            sftp_hlp, "getInterfaces", return_value=interfaces
        ), patch.object(sftp_hlp, "which", return_value="/usr/sbin/sshd"), patch.object(
            sftp_hlp.subprocess, "run", return_value=sshd_result
        ):
            info = sftp_hlp.get_sftp_connection_info()

        self.assertEqual(info["hostname"], "new21.dvestezar.cz")
        self.assertEqual(info["public_ipv4"], "8.8.8.8")
        self.assertEqual(info["tun_ipv4"], "10.8.88.1")
        self.assertEqual(info["port"], "2222")

# Changelog

## v2.10.2

- UX SFTP Manager 1.3.5 přidává do mailu s klíčem i ZIP README kompletní připojovací blok: hostname z `machineInfo.hostname_full`, lokálně dostupnou veřejnou IPv4, `tun*` VPN IPv4 a efektivní SSH/SFTP port z `sshd -T`. Hostname je primární adresa; IP údaje jsou záložní/diagnostické. Zjišťování nepoužívá žádnou externí public-IP službu.
